probe4Models.title: Probe4 model config
probe4Models.desc: probe4 model config (~/.probe4/agent/models.json): providers, their models, and the default. API keys go to a separate credentials file, never into models.json.
probe4Models.apiKeyDesc: The key literal is written per provider into probe4's credential file (~/.probe4/agent/.credentials.json) and read directly by the probe4 runtime. It is not injected as a process environment variable nor written into models.json.
probe4Models.name: name
probe4Models.importDesc: Paste JSON (single or array of {provider, apiKeyEnv?, displayName?, api?, baseURL?, models}): existing provider is overwritten, otherwise appended.
probe4Models.importInvalid: Invalid JSON or wrong shape (expected {provider, models:[]})
probe4Models.discoverEmpty: Click "Scan models" to list all models on this endpoint
probe4Models.discoverUseConfigured: Listing not supported · use {{count}} configured models instead
